FRANKIE JR. R. SALAR SK Chairperson Barangay Cagniog Surigao City, Surigao del Norte Dear SK Chairperson Salar: This pertains to your undated letter requesting for this Department's legal opinion on whether Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) Secretary or any elected SK Members can be appointed either Officer-in-Charge (OIC) — SK Treasurer or SK Treasurer — in an acting capacity. Foremost, we would like to inform you that the Department has already settled in its previous opinions that an elective or appointive local official is not allowed to hold in any capacity (either via appointment or designation) other office in the Government, its subdivision, agency or instrumentality, including GOCC, unless specifically allowed by law. This is the clear significance of Section 94(a) of the Local Government Code of 1991 (LGC), which provides: "(a) No elective or appointive local official shall be eligible for appointment or designation in any capacity to any public office or position during his tenure. Unless otherwise allowed by law or by the primary functions of his position, no elective or appointive local official shall hold any other office or employment in the government or any subdivision, agency or instrumentality thereof, including govemment-owned or controlled corporations or their subsidiaries. " This opinion shall be without prejudice to any contrary opinion rendered by more competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you on the matter. Thank you.
